The '''88th Mechanized Assault Group''' was an [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]]. This unit fielded [[Blue|light blue]]-[[gray]] stock [[TIE crawler/Legends|century tanks]] during the [[Imperial Civil War]]<ref name="SWPM" /> that erupted in the wake of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] dissolution in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
An 88th Mechanized century tank miniature labeled as a "TIE Crawler"&mdash;another name for the compact assault vehicle&mdash;was featured in the ''''[[Ground Assault]]' expansion of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]'', released [[November 14]], [[2007]].<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://www.tcgplayer.com/db/game_review.asp?AID=2016&PID=28&DBID=4|text=Ground Assault In Stores Now!|archivedate=20100117061457}}</ref> The miniature's printed base stand listed balanced values and lacked icons for equipment or ability enhancements&mdash;such as the enhanced-[[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] found on the [[221st Mechanized Assault Group]].<ref name="Card-SWPM-221st Mechanized TIE crawler">{{PocketModel|set=Ground Assault|cardname=221st Mechanized TIE crawler|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipga03c.jpg}}</ref> This represented the 88th Mechanized Assault Group as fielding stock vehicles.<ref name="SWPM" />
